name: Example Plugin
description: Reference dynamically-loaded add-on (ribbon tab + EX_HELLO command).

name: Open Infra Studio
description: GIS and civil design for infrastructure: project location in any coordinate system, 600+ WMS/WFS/tile services worldwide, OpenStreetMap, CityGML/CityJSON, alignments, profiles and corridors, plus Dutch base data (BGT, BRK, KLIC, AHN) to NLCS.

name: Storm Sewer
description: Gravity storm-drain network design and analysis (Rational + Manning + HGL, LandXML import). Free to draw and analyze; Pro ($29/yr) adds HTML reports, pipe sizing, multi-RP.

name: HydroComplete
description: Full stormwater hydrology and hydraulics — mirrors HydroComplete for Civil 3D (HC_ANALYZE, HC_REVIEW, KaTeX HTML reports, Atlas 14, BMP/WQV, LandXML).

name: Land Survey
description: Survey points, PNEZD & LandXML import, TIN surfaces, earthwork volumes, COGO, and coordinate transforms (RTS / Helmert / resection).

name: MCP Bridge
description: Read/write bridge for external tools: serves the live selection and accepts draw/remove requests over a local socket (MCP servers, scripts).

name: Python REPL Plugin
description: Out-of-process V4 plugin for Open CAD Studio that opens an IPython REPL in an OS terminal window bound to the active document tab. Python code reads the live document through a zero-copy shared-memory snapshot and mutates it through the plugin API. Limited to entity types Point, Line, Circle, Arc, Ellipse, Polyline, Polyline2D, Polyline3D, LwPolyline, Spline, MText and XData

name: Construction Layers & Guides
description: Construction layers, infinite lines, rays, reference circles and LibreCAD/FreeCAD drafting guides with real-time viewport preview and auto-conversion.
